headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 3, 2026**
article:
The Miami Marlins secured a 4-1 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Max Meyer pitching 7.0 innings and allowing just 1 ER. Esteury Ruiz led the Marlins' offense with a home run and 1 RBI. The Detroit Tigers took down the Tampa Bay Rays 7-2, with Dillon Dingler leading the offense and Troy Melton dominating on the mound. The Chicago White Sox shut out the Minnesota Twins 8-0, with Andrew Benintendi leading the offense with a home run and 2 RBIs. The New York Mets secured a 7-1 victory over the Seattle Mariners, with Freddy Peralta earning the win after pitching 6.0 innings with 6 strikeouts and 1 earned run. J.P. Crawford led the Mariners' offense with 3 hits, including a home run.

Several players have been moved to the injured list, impacting their team's availability. Trevor Story has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a sports hernia. Sean Murphy has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a fractured left middle finger. Joe Mantiply has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to left knee inflammation. Travis d'Arnaud has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right foot plantar fasciitis. Matt Gage has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 2, 2026, due to right knee inflammation. Rob Zastryzny has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 31, 2026, due to a left trapezius strain. Nick Sogard has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to May 31, 2026, due to a right oblique strain. Jonathan Heasley has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 29, 2026.

Several roster moves have been made. The Cincinnati Reds traded RHP Kyle Nicolas to the Baltimore Orioles for cash. The Los Angeles Angels traded C Austin Wynns to the Atlanta Braves for cash. The Minnesota Twins traded RHP Simeon Woods Richardson to the Toronto Blue Jays for cash. The Pittsburgh Pirates traded RHP Justin Lawrence to the Minnesota Twins for cash.
